change_from_v1: Before any distribution result was computed, clarify that the 2023 training corpus inherits historical forecast/reference admission whereas 2026 cases are forecast-only strict-QC admissions. All source hashes, the fixed 1301-cell footprint, all-dynamic-feature rule, month/lead strata and descriptive statistics remain as in v1.
preprotocol_inspection_disclosure: The existing full-year 2026 range-warning counts and one 2023/2026 static-grid smoke case were inspected before this comparison protocol. This is exploratory, not a new independent validation or a prespecified model-selection test.
case_admission_limit: The source case populations are not matched by date, weather event or admission process. Use every available June-September 2023 training case and every sealed 2026 strict-QC lead in its month/lead stratum. Exclude the eight October 2023 training cases. Do not interpret distribution differences as GEFS executable effects or rainfall skill.
allowed_read: Only the hash-verified 2023 feature matrix, its case and pixel-index metadata, the sealed 2026 forecast-only feature arrays and their source receipts; never observed rainfall targets, 2026 observation values, reanalysis or score arrays.
